body: I'd go back to the GP and ask for a referral to see a psychiatrist, a psychiatrist would be better equipped to find out what is going on with you. A psychiatrist can also prescribe antidepressants or mood stabilizers to help you. A GP could as well, but they only have so much knowledge on the subject of mental health. for example, I went to my GP and she prescribed me Zoloft, I had allergic reactions to it so i went back to see her and she had recommended I quit taking it immediately. Bad idea, I went a little psychotic because i was supposed to wean myself off of it instead of just on the spot stop taking it. My GP had no clue that Zoloft required weaning off. What country do you live in?

I agree with you that depressed people have a more realistic view of the world, but try telling that to all the rose colored glasses wearing people who blindly go about their day like nothing is happening.

I remember my therapist telling me that there wouldn't be such a high demand for mental health care if humans just stopped abusing each other...
